description: Nicole Borden, the owner of a quaint arts and crafts store, is faced with an ultimatum when her competitor tells her that she must either sell her store or be forced out of business.

title: A Charming Valentine

title: From Chicago With Love
description: Poppy is a marketing specialist whose life is turned upside down when she fakes an engagement with her boss's handsome new client Milo, to win over her strict building manager and get Milo the penthouse suite.

title: Love in Aruba
description: Amber joins single father Connor overseas in Aruba to tutor and watch over his daughter, Macey, while he focuses on work.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E19 — Mayberry on Record
Andy suspects that Mr Maxwell, a record producer visiting Mayberry, might be a con artist. He tries to convince Barney that he is being swindled after he invests in Mr Maxwell's record company.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E20 — Andy Saves Barney's Morale
Barney is left in charge of the sheriff's department when Andy has to leave Mayberry for the day to testify in a court case. When Andy returns, he finds out that Barney arrested almost half the town.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E21 — Andy and the Gentleman Crook
A nationally known confidence man becomes a hero to Aunt Bee, Opie and Barney when he is held in jail.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E22 — Cyrano Andy
Andy tries to help Barney win the heart of his girlfriend, Thelma Lou. Everything goes smoothly until Barney misinterprets Andy's efforts and thinks he is trying to steal her away.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E23 — Andy and Opie, Housekeepers
Aunt Bee scolds Andy and Opie for being slobs before leaving town for a few days. Soon, the Taylor home becomes a complete wreck, but Andy and Opie are determined to clean up before Aunt Bee returns.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E24 — The New Doctor
Andy finally proposes to Ellie when he thinks that the new doctor in town is trying to turn her head.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E25 — A Plaque for Mayberry
The entire town is shocked when they discover that Otis, the town drunk, is a direct descendant of a Revolutionary War hero.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E26 — The Inspector
Andy and Barney find out that the state inspector is a stickler for rules. Andy wins the inspector over when he manages to apprehend a shooter without any injuries.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E27 — Ellie Saves a Female
Ellie takes pity on Frankie, the shy daughter of a farmer, and decides to give her a makeover, much to the displeasure of her gruff father.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E28 — Andy Forecloses
Andy, tasked with serving an eviction notice on the Scobey family, tries his best to save them from getting evicted from their home.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E29 — Quiet Sam
Barney becomes increasingly suspicious of the new farmer in town. Andy agrees to pay him a visit and finds himself pulled into an unforgettable experience.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E30 — Barney Gets His Man
Barney becomes the toast of Mayberry when he helps capture an escaped convict. It goes to his head until the man escapes and returns to exact revenge on Barney.

title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

title: Christmas by Candlelight
description: Juliet pitches selling Christmas memory candles to her boss, and asks candle store owner Tom to create new scents. He refuses at first but agrees after realizing the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
description: A woman receives help from a selfless neighbor when an arm injury puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy.

title: A Very Curious Christmas
description: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E31 — The Guitar Player Returns
Jim Lindsey, a guitarist from Mayberry who becomes famous while playing in a band, returns to town after failing his solo career.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E32 — Bringing Up Opie
Aunt Bee scolds Opie and tells him to stay away from the courthouse after he handcuffs a classmate to a flagpole; Opie, annoyed at the situation, decides to run away from home.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E01 — Opie and the Bully
Andy learns that a bully has been demanding Opie's milk money at school. Andy must decide whether to intervene or let Opie deal with the bully and learn to stand up for himself.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E02 — Barney's Replacement
Barney resigns when he believes Andy is trying to ease him out of his job as deputy.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E03 — Andy and the Woman Speeder
An attractive out-of-town woman gets a speeding ticket from Andy. While waiting for her trial, she uses flattery and bribes to sway the witnesses for the prosecution.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E04 — Mayberry Goes Bankrupt
A citizen of Mayberry forestalls his eviction by trying to redeem a century-old municipal bond.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E05 — Barney on the Rebound
Barney becomes smitten with Melissa after he helps her cross the street and soon has dinner with her and her supposed dad. Before Barney can realize what is happening, she announces that they are engaged.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E06 — Opie's Hobo Friend
Andy and Opie go fishing and encounter an unhoused person, who later becomes friends with Opie and negatively impacts his conscience.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E07 — Crime-Free Mayberry
A bogus FBI agent and his accomplice nearly make off with the Mayberry bank's money.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E08 — The Perfect Female
Thelma Lou and Barney play matchmaker for Andy and Karen, Thelma Lou's attractive cousin. However, Barney slips up, making Karen think that Andy is as crude as Barney makes him out to be.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E09 — Aunt Bee's Brief Encounter
Aunt Bee hires Mr Wheeler, an itinerant handyman, to help around the Taylor home. She has taken a liking to him, but Andy discovers that he is actually a freeloader.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E10 — The Clubmen
Andy accepts a friend's offer to join an exclusive club and brings along Barney, who makes a fool of himself by putting on airs. Andy soon learns that only he has been selected for membership.

description: Breaking news for New York City and the surrounding area.

title: Just in Time
description: Experience Tony Bennett in London's Royal Albert Hall on Mar. 2, 1974; the performance showcases Bennett's vocal prowess and charisma.

title: The Engagement Plan
description: Wade thinks he has the perfect plan to propose to his girlfriend, Kayla. However, when she asks him to go to her family's farm instead, he soon finds himself in an uphill battle to win their approval.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E14 — The Ape
Adam and Little Joe warn Hoss when he tries to help Arnie, a man with the mind of a child and an uncontrollable temper.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E15 — The Blood Line
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E16 — The Courtship
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E17 — The Spitfire
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E19 — The Gunmen
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E20 — The Fear Merchants
A potential mayoral candidate attempts to stir up trouble between majority and minority groups in town.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E21 — Spanish Grant
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E23 — Desert Justice
A Ponderosa ranch hand faces charges of killing the wife of the U.S. marshal who came to arrest him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E24 — The Stranger
As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E27 — The Last Trophy
Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E28 — San Francisco
Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.
